diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle with a 3-minute period. The candidate executes the body once and then terminates (missing the final delay implies the cycle ended, but the action order and repetition logic are wrong: the IR performs Call -> Delay -> Call, then repeats every 3 mins. The candidate does Call -> Delay -> Call -> Delay(3 MIN), effectively running the sequence once and waiting forever. The mismatch at 190000ms (1m50s) indicates the IR is starting a new cycle iteration (Call Siren) while the candidate has already finished its single run and is stuck in the final delay.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed 'period' from 0 to 180000 to make the script repeating. Rewrote the script to execute the body actions (Call Siren, Delay 10s, Call Switch) inside the periodic loop without a trailing delay, allowing the cycle to re-arm immediately after the last action for the next 3-minute iteration.
